ValidationRule.description: Stage cannot be Booked unless at least one Service has been added.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Service_Count__c = 0 && OR( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Booked") ,ISPICKVAL( StageName , "In Progress"),ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Completed"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Stage cannot be Booked ,Inprogress or completed unless at least one Service has been added.
